svg.aria-label: The one I follow: Jake Sully, Toruk Makto. A hand-drawn sketch of Jake in his Na'vi form.
svg.title: The One I Follow · Jake Sully

g.text: Toruk Makto · Olo’eyktan of the Omatikaya
Sometimes your whole life boils down
He showed up knowing nothing and learned a whole world.
Same plan for every new stack I pick up.
